header: Integrations that keep the back office in sync
subheadline: Nine connections ship as standard and need no middleware. These four are the ones a finance team asks about in the first meeting, and each runs on a schedule you set rather than on a manual export.

items.title: DATEV
items.description_text: Job sheets, parts and hours posted as bookable entries, with cost centres per contract.

items.title: BMD NTCS
items.description_text: Nightly transfer of closed work orders, credit notes and technician time records.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID
items.description_text: Single sign-on, and automatic deactivation when a technician leaves the payroll system.

items.title: Sage 50
items.description_text: Draft invoices raised from signed job sheets, with your own numbering ranges preserved.
